title: AlRaso human ReviewDecision artifact
description: Deterministic machine-readable record of an explicit HUMAN legal-review decision over a review case. The artifact binds cryptographically to the exact review case (case_sha256), the exact candidate fixture (candidate_fixture_sha256) and the exact evidence the reviewer claims to have reviewed (reviewed_evidence). It is the only legitimate input to the gated publication path (alraso.publish_reviewed). Nothing in this schema permits an automated system to create a valid APPROVE: reviewer identity, timestamp and evidence hashes must correspond to a real adjudication.

case_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form of the review case (json.dumps sort_keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8)

candidate_fixture_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical candidate_fixture.json. REQUIRED for APPROVE; binds approval to exact proposed rule content.

name.description: Human reviewer identity (real person, not a tool)

reference.description: Verifiable reference for the reviewer (credential, contact, attestation id)

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the human decision

reviewed_evidence.description: Map evidence-key -> sha256. Must cover: the case extract file (recomputed on disk), 'source:akn_sha256' or 'source:pdf_sha256' (attestation binding to the case-declared source hash), and the geometry reference file (recomputed). Extra keys allowed for additional reviewed artifacts.

spatial_disposition.description: Reviewer disposition of the spatial/geometry question. APPROVE requires REVIEWED or NOT_APPLICABLE.

annotation.description: Reviewer's free-text basis for the decision
